what: a quarter-cylinder sheet r 10, 20 high, with a square window cut through it at 45 degrees, untrimmed in place: the cylinder face whole again
method: the window's loop is projected onto the cylinder along the sketch normal (1,1,0)/sqrt2 and cut out; untrimming every hole leaves the quarter cylinder: A = (pi/2) 10 20 = 314.16, one cylinder face with 4 free edges (two arcs, two rulings)
